title: Lead Principal Physical Security Engineer, Hyperscale Data Center Construction (Saline Township, MI)
description:
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is expanding its data center portfolio to support global cloud and AI infrastructure. The Physical Security Systems team works across design, construction, commissioning, and operations to deliver reliable security systems for these facilities.

This Lead Principal Physical Security Systems Engineer serves as a senior technical authority for physical security systems on complex data center construction projects. The role works with design, construction, security operations, networking, commissioning, and vendor teams to ensure systems meet OCI standards and are ready for operational use.

**NOTE: This is a full-time role located onsite at our new hyperscale facility in Saline Township, Michigan. Relocation assistance will be provided.**

**Required Qualifications**

* Significant experience designing, delivering, or managing physical security systems in data centers, mission-critical facilities, large campuses, or similarly secure environments.

* Strong knowledge of access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection, intercoms, perimeter security, and security monitoring platforms.

* Experience reviewing construction drawings, specifications, submittals, device schedules, and commissioning documentation.

* Understanding of low-voltage construction, structured cabling, device installation, labeling, testing, and system integration.

* Proven ability to manage integrators, contractors, and vendors while coordinating with cross-functional teams.

* Ability to identify technical, quality, and schedule risks and communicate clearly with field teams and leadership.

* Experience reviewing vendor scope, change orders, pricing, and schedule impacts.

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, construction management, information technology, security management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

* Ability to travel as needed for project delivery and site reviews.

**You’ll own and influence category strategy across the data center portfolio while developing the people, supplier relationships, and processes needed to support continued growth.**

title: AI Infrastructure Operations Engineer - Compute & Storage - Highrise AI
description: About Highrise AI   Highrise AI is a GPU-native infrastructure platform built for modern AI workloads. Designed for developers and enterprises operating in performance-critical and security-sensitive environments, Highrise delivers scalable GPU compute across dedicated clusters, managed cloud, and confidential environments.   Highrise combines bare-metal performance with full-stack orchestration, API-driven access, and hardware-enforced isolation to support training, fine-tuning, and production-scale deployment of AI models. From reserved GPU capacity to enterprise-grade confidential compute, Highrise provides flexible infrastructure models tailored to the needs of builders operating at scale.   Beyond infrastructure, Highrise integrates disciplined operations, advanced automation, and on-site engineering expertise to sustain high uptime and predictable performance across deployments.
